assignmentHtml.task: Research Zack D. Films YouTube channel comprehensively. Find: (1) Stable channel ID and canonical URL. (2) Operator/creator - who runs this channel? (3) Channel creation date and earliest still-public upload. (4) Operating location and displayed country. (5) Languages. (6) Primary content category. (7) Content supply model. (8) Representative series. Provide direct source URLs.
assignmentHtml.context: Zack D. Films is #21/#22 with ~75-76B lifetime views per Communitrics snapshot dated September 2, 2026. Need verifiable facts with source links.
assignmentHtml.expected_output: A structured dossier for Zack D. Films with all requested fields, each with source URLs.

answerHtml:
Zack D. Films — Comprehensive Channel Dossier

(1) Stable Channel ID and Canonical URL:

  • Channel ID: UCvz84_Q0BbvZThy75mbd-Dg [1][2]
  • Canonical handle URL: https://www.youtube.com/@zackdfilms [3]
  • Also accessible at: https://www.youtube.com/channel/UCvz84_Q0BbvZThy75mbd-Dg [2]
  • Current stats: 28.4M subscribers, ~3.9K videos, ~76.6B lifetime views [4]

(2) Operator/Creator:

  • Zachary Brian Dziadul (born December 28, 1992), American YouTuber and 3D animator. Founder and producer of Zack D. Films LLC. Attended Butler Community College (2013–2015) and Fort Hays State University (2015–2017), both in Kansas. [5][6]
  • Legal entity: Zack D. Films LLC, a Texas limited liability company. [7]

(3) Channel Creation Date and Earliest Still-Public Upload:

  • Channel created: June 7, 2021 [5][8]
  • First upload: "The Buc-ee's Empire" on June 8, 2021 — still public with ~1.1M views as of September 2026. [5][9]

(4) Operating Location and Displayed Country:

  • Operating location: Austin, Texas, USA. Trademark registration address: 5900 Balcones Drive, Suite 100, Austin, TX 78731-4298. [7]
  • Displayed country: United States, per Wikipedia's "List of most-viewed YouTube channels" table and multiple analytics platforms. [10][11]

(5) Languages:

  • Primary language: English (narration and content). Wikipedia lists primary language as English. [10]
  • No confirmed multi-language audio tracks; audience geography includes US, UK, Canada, India, Brazil, Germany, Australia, Japan per Vidiq analytics. [11]

(6) Primary Content Category:

  • Wikipedia classification: Entertainment. [10]
  • Self-described: "A Collection of Things I Find Interesting" — fact-based edutainment shorts covering science, history, human anatomy, everyday phenomena, hypothetical scenarios, and occasional fiction. TV Tropes describes it as an "Edutainment Show." [12]

(7) Content Supply Model:

  • In-house, self-produced animation studio. Produces ~40 short-form scripts per week in a mostly fixed format. [13]
  • Team: Almost 300 employees and ~200 animators as of August 2026 per Fandom wiki [14]; LinkedIn lists 51–200 employees (118 shown). [13]
  • Process: Script writers, fact-checkers, 3D animators, editors. Content is primarily high-retention YouTube Shorts (~1 min), with occasional long-form documentaries (~8 total). [14][15]
  • Monetization: Brand sponsorships via partnerships.zackdfilms.com, licensing, and ad revenue. [13]

(8) Representative Series:

  • "Patent Pending" — launched June 10, 2026; animated shorts where Zack discusses fictional invention ideas. [12]
  • "The Hidden AirTag" — 3-part fiction thriller series (parts 1–3 uploaded March 1, March 22, and April 12, 2025). [16]
  • Fiction shorts category — regular standalone horror/thriller fiction shorts since March 2025 (e.g., "The Trunk Had No Bottom," "The Haunted Lighthouse"). [16]
  • Long-form documentary specials (e.g., "The Full Story of Norman," "The Pepsi Contest That Killed 5 People"). [15]

Notes on discrepancies:

  • Employee count: Fandom wiki states ~300 employees / 200 animators (Aug 2026) while LinkedIn states 51–200 with 118 listed. Both confirm substantial in-house production capacity.
  • Views: Wikipedia lists 72.9B (likely snapshot date); SocialBlade/Vidiq show ~76.6B as of Sept 2026. Communitrics snapshot referenced in task context (~75–76B) aligns with these figures.
